About NJRUI Mobile Home

JIRUI WEIVE Co., Ltd. — a core enterprise of the Jiuce Holding Group, specializing in modular, prefabricated and mobile steel-structure housing.

A Factory Built for Scale

From our headquarters in Lianyungang, Jiangsu, we operate four affiliated factories — Lianyungang, Baoding (Hebei), Ziyang (Sichuan) and Huainan (Anhui) — covering a total production base of 1,700,000 m². Our 700+ customizable product types range from folding expandable container houses and flat pack container houses to modular prefab houses, site camp accommodation, prefab villas, capsule rooms and customized container units.

100% industrialized standardized manufacturing means every house leaves the factory as a finished product: on site, only water and power hook-up are required. Products are delivered by flatbed truck, low-bed trailer or container, and erected by crane — from lift-off to utilities in hours, with professional guidance throughout.

We serve partners in 30+ countries with CE, ISO and SGS certified quality, and hold multiple invention, utility-model and design patents.
